detail: File is the complete publisher-typeset chapter 5 (Mares, Seligman, Restall, 'Situations, Constraints and Channels', pp.329-344, 2nd ed. 2011), exact version. The entry requires all 26 second-edition chapters plus apparatus, the 1997 DRT chapter (pp.179-236), the Partee 2001 manuscript and the Steedman 2005 draft; only this one chapter is held from this URL.

File is a complete author LaTeX preprint (66 pp., own pagination) of chapter 3, Autebert-Berstel-Boasson 'Context-free languages and push-down automata' (Springer printed pp.111-174); its version differs from the required Springer 1997 first edition (not publisher typesetting). The entry requires chapters 1-12 plus preface, contents and back matter of Handbook of Formal Languages vol.1; only this one chapter (in a different version) is held.

File is the complete author-hosted chapter 3 (Graedel, 'Finite Model Theory and Descriptive Complexity', pp.125-230, 106 pp., pdfTeX 2007-04-25; sha256 differs from the recorded value, which per spec/research/acquisition-src-050.md hashes a text capture). The entry requires chapters 1-7 of the Springer 2007 book and the other author chapter versions (Spencer, Libkin, Kolaitis-Vardi); only chapter 3 is held.

Listed URL is the IOS Press contents page (no body). Guest-free items were downloaded via each item's own Download PDF button: Front Matter (pp.i-xvii), Part I and Part II openers, Subject Index (pp.1371-1427), Cited Author Index (pp.1429-1462). All 34 chapters show 'Order' only (none open access) and 'List of the Contributors' has no free download, so the required complete chapters and author manuscripts are not obtainable from this host without purchase.

Mirrored all 215 HTML pages reachable within https://lean-lang.org/doc/reference/4.34.0-rc1/ (all HTTP 200, every page shows 4.34.0-rc1); all 29 top-level units and their subpages are present (HTML only; CSS/JS/fonts not mirrored). Not shown: content identity with the 12 Aug 2026 capture (the live path may have been rebuilt). Not obtained: the legacy Lean 3.3.0 reference PDF and comparison material (unit ED26-SRC-052-0900), which is not at this URL.

Full Rocq 9.0.0 reference manual obtained as the official PDF linked from the listed V9.0.0 refman index page (GitHub release asset, 969 pp., body pp.1-952 complete); it covers the 9.0.0 divisions (units 0201-0208) in PDF rather than HTML presentation. The entry's 50 presentations also require the 9.0+alpha docs-master and 9.4+alpha master captures, 9.0.1 (v9.0 alias), 9.1.1 and 9.2 manuals and auxiliary version evidence (0900); those are not obtained.

File is the complete, exact Isabelle2025-2 'Programming and Proving in Isabelle/HOL' (65 pp., Jan 18, 2026), covering unit ED26-SRC-054-0001 only. The entry's 42 presentations cover the whole Isabelle2025-2 documentation catalogue (locales, classes, datatypes, functions, codegen, Nitpick, Sledgehammer, Isar reference/implementation/system manuals, logics, ANNOUNCE/README/NEWS etc.) and apparatus; those other 40 documents are not obtained.

Mirrored the v2.8.0 Language Reference: index plus all 50 entry pages (HTTP 200, all labelled Agda 2.8.0), matching units ED26-SRC-055-0201..0250. The entry's 253 presentations also require the captured stable-2.8.0 and latest-2.9.0 captures, Agda 2.6.4.3 and 2.6.4 entries, the user-manual PDF presentations (0701-0704) and comparison apparatus; those are not obtained.

File is the complete, exact Russian translation (first-edition-1287-g1ac9408, 502 pp.), covering units ED26-SRC-056-0201..0213. The entry's 41 presentations also require the first-edition-78-g0bb33d2 e-book (0001-0013), the arXiv 1308.0729v1 / first-edition-257-g5561b73 manifestation (0101-0113) and comparison apparatus (0900, 0999); those are not obtained.

File is the complete 2014 author record of chapter 3 'Modeling for Verification' (34 pp.), covering that one author-record unit only. The entry's 43 presentations require all 32 chapters of the 2018 Springer Handbook of Model Checking, the other author records and the corrections item; those are not obtained.
